title: optimization.requested (v1)
description: Dispatch of an optimization job. Published by job-orchestrator's outbox relay to `lean.jobs` with routing key `jobs.optimization.v1`, AMQP type `jobs.v1.OptimizationRequested`. Consumed by the optimizer, which runs LEAN's `IOptimizationStrategy` and submits every parameter set as a child backtest through `POST /internal/v1/jobs` (ADR 0001); children carry `parentJobId` = this job id. Acked after the optimization's terminal event is confirmed.

jobId.description: Also the optimization id (`OptimizationId` in child packets).
